sections.name: Authentication & Authorization
sections.notes: Login, signup, logout, refresh, password reset, 2FA, sessions, and role-based access fully implemented.

sections.name: Users & Team Management
sections.notes: User CRUD, invitations, roles, API keys, profile updates, and team management endpoints implemented.

sections.name: Shipments
sections.notes: Full shipment lifecycle: CRUD, status updates, proof upload, documents, photos, disputes, timeline, ETA, export.

sections.name: Addresses (Address Book)
sections.notes: No address module or routes found in codebase. Address book CRUD endpoints not implemented.

sections.name: Analytics
sections.notes: Performance endpoint implemented. Summary endpoint with sparklines not yet implemented.

sections.name: Settlements / Escrow
sections.notes: Settlements list and detail endpoints implemented. Escrow contract integration and payment orchestration incomplete.

sections.name: Blockchain Ledger
sections.notes: Ledger blocks endpoint exists but router not mounted in app.ts. On-chain milestone indexing partial.

sections.name: Anomalies
sections.notes: Anomaly listing, stats, and resolution endpoints fully implemented with cursor pagination.

sections.name: Notifications
sections.notes: Basic notification CRUD implemented. Preferences, OTP, and read-all endpoints not yet implemented.

sections.name: Activity Feed
sections.notes: Activity feed endpoint implemented with pagination.

sections.name: Public Tracking
sections.notes: No public tracking endpoint found. Unauthenticated shipment lookup not implemented.

sections.name: Real-Time Events (SSE + Polling)
sections.notes: SSE endpoint implemented. Polling fallback endpoint not yet implemented.

sections.name: Stellar / Soroban Blockchain
sections.notes: Shipment tokenization and telemetry anchoring implemented. Escrow contract deployment and Soroban integration incomplete.

sections.name: File Upload Requirements
sections.notes: Proof, documents, photos, and dispute evidence upload endpoints implemented with MIME type and size validation.

sections.name: CORS, Cookies & Security
sections.notes: CORS with credentials enabled, rate limiting on auth endpoints, Helmet security headers, JWT authentication implemented.
